job.title: Senior Consultant Support SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service (m/w/d) - (Vollzeit / Teilzeit)

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Developer & Consultant | Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs & PIM/ERP Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience building, extending and supporting SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL performance tuning, and data integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM. Experienced in techno-functional consulting, requirements analysis, process mapping, and agile delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with strong technical and stakeholder management skills.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Consultant Support SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: ORBIS SE's reputation for delivering top-tier SAP enterprise solutions strongly aligns with my professional background. Bringing over 5 years of specialized SAP Commerce and Java experience from enterprise engagements at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to contribute immediately to your consulting and support team.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Bridged business and technical domains at Rockwell Automation by analysing requirements, writing functional specifications, and designing robust SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions.

bullets.label: System Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, resolving complex integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: API & Headless Architecture
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless third-party and PWA integrations.

bullets.label: Production Support & Optimization
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, led database query refactoring to reduce response latency, and delivered dedicated troubleshooting and maintenance at Shell.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my SAP expertise can support ORBIS SE.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Consultant Support SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Die exzellente Positionierung der ORBIS SE als führender Partner für SAP-Unternehmenslösungen motiviert mich sehr, meine Expertise in Ihr Team einzubringen. Mit über 5 Jahren fundierter Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Betreuung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Plattformen bei globalen Unternehmen wie Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefgehendes technisches und prozessuales Know-how mit.

bullets.label: Techno-Funktionale Beratung & Analyse
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation fungierte ich als Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und IT: Ich analysierte Anforderungen, erstellte User Stories sowie funktionale Spezifikationen und übersetzte diese in passgenaue SAP Commerce-Lösungen.

bullets.label: Integration & Datenflüsse
bullets.text: Konzipierte und optimierte PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mittels Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub und löste komplexe Integrationsengpässe zwischen SAP ERP-, MDM- und E-Commerce-Systemen.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung & Headless Architekturen
bullets.text: Entwickelte und bereitete OCC REST Web Services (Headless APIs) vor und passte Interceptoren, Populatoren sowie Converter für kundenspezifische Datenströme an.

bullets.label: Support & Performance-Optimierung
bullets.text: Begleitete CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen auf CCv2 bei Shell, führte Datenbankabfrage-Refatorings zur Latenzsenkung durch und unterstützte aktiv die Fehlerbehebung im Produktivbetrieb.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine unbeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer ordentlichen Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026. Mein frühester Eintrittstermin ist der 16.12.2026. Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: ORBIS SE's strong market standing in delivering comprehensive SAP solutions for enterprise clients makes it an ideal environment for my SAP Commerce expertise. I am eager to apply my 5+ years of techno-functional experience in bridging business requirements and technical integrations to drive success for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise, techno-functional consulting skills, and robust system integration experience to support ORBIS SE's enterprise clients.
tailoring.message_to_recruiter: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience across Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong techno-functional skills in integration, API development, and business analysis. My last working day is 15.12.2026 (earliest start 16.12.2026). Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Consultant Support SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Senior Consultant Support SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service role at ORBIS SE.

With over 5 years of professional experience as an SAP Commerce Developer and Techno-Functional Consultant at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, PIM/ERP integrations, and agile support environments. 

I possess a valid German work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to ORBIS.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
